features/admin.name: Admin
features/admin.notes: Full A+ coverage achieved. Fixed: native alert/confirm → toast/modal, as any cast → proper types, hardcoded colors → theme vars. Already had: proper DI, extracted child components, aria-labels, efficient queries, audit logging.

features/settings.name: Settings
features/settings.notes: Clean architecture with DI services, modern Svelte 5 patterns, good accessibility. Minor: missing error state for save failures, vestigial settings-module-state file.

features/create.name: Create
features/create.notes: Well-architected composition root with clean service separation. Minor code quality issues (helper files, some any types). Svelte 5 100% compliant. Accessibility gaps in focus styling (outline:none without focus-visible). Good UX states. Theme variables used correctly. No barrel exports. Security safe.

features/discover/creators.name: Discover > Creators
features/discover/creators.notes: Clean architecture with proper separation. Full Svelte 5 runes. All UX states handled. Issues: touch target on back button and error dismiss (below 48px), redundant CSS fallbacks, hover effects on non-interactive stat cards, modal backdrop role should be presentation.

shared/i18n.name: Shared: I18n
shared/i18n.notes: Security documentation added for param sanitization requirements. ARIA live region added for locale change announcements. All 8 dimensions now A+.

features/admin/components.name: Admin Components
features/admin/components.notes: Clean architecture with proper DI. 2 issues: (1) AnnouncementManagement uses native confirm() instead of AdminModal, (2) hardcoded rgba colors in DailyChallengeScheduler and AnnouncementManagement. All Svelte 5 patterns, good a11y with focus states and ARIA.

features/background-builder/components.name: Background Builder Components
features/background-builder/components.notes: Clean Svelte 5 code, good DI usage, proper animation cleanup. Accessibility gaps: font sizes below 12px, missing slider focus indicators, inconsistent reduced-motion. See fix plan for A+ path.
